performance_case.causal_mechanism: A point-in-time D-1 expiry-futures inventory plus complete confirmed D-day futures and index raw atoms can test whether lagged fixed-maturity crypto carry contains independent admission information without same-day leakage.
performance_case.claim_boundary: Local completion proves only static creation of five offline files. Manager executable validation is mandatory before acceptance, and neither layer can prove endpoint availability, prediction, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, deployment, OOS or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any future reduction in adverse DRA entry path or maximum drawdown remains MISSING_PROOF until a preregistered matched-capital experiment passes Validation and sealed OOS.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Failing closed on Local Python made no progress but preserved evidence integrity. Moving executable acceptance to Manager recovers implementation throughput without sandbox permission prompts; a bad five-file slice is still rejected before commit, source activation or evidence collection.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The contract cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL directly, but it reduces time to a credible accept-or-reject test of one primary-supported carry mechanism while preventing after-the-fact instrument selection, backfill and duplicate funding work.
